# Free LLM Models

> Free LLM Models is a searchable directory of currently free AI models across OpenRouter, Groq, Google AI Studio, Cerebras, Mistral, Hugging Face, and NVIDIA NIM.

The catalog is refreshed from provider APIs. Availability, limits, model policies, and pricing can change; verify important details with the provider before production use.

## Agent Resources

This site is agent-ready. Discoverable resources:

- [Agent Skills Index](/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json) - Discoverable skills and resources
- [API Catalog](/.well-known/api-catalog) - Machine-readable API endpoints (RFC 9727) — also at /.well-known/api-catalog.json
- [A2A Agent Card](/.well-known/agent-card.json) - Agent-to-agent discovery (also /.well-known/agent.json)
- [MCP Server Card](/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json) - Model Context Protocol server (also /.well-known/mcp.json)
- [ARD Manifest](/.well-known/ai-catalog.json) - Agentic Resource Discovery (also /.well-known/ard.json)
- [Auth.md](/Auth.md) - Authentication and API key policy
- [OAuth Authorization Server](/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server) - OAuth 2.0 discovery (RFC 8414)
- [OAuth Protected Resource](/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource) - Protected resource metadata (RFC 9728)
- [JWKS](/.well-known/jwks.json) - JSON Web Key Set
- [WebMCP manifest](/.well-known/webmcp.json) - Browser tool definitions
- [robots.txt](/robots.txt) - Crawl rules and AI content preferences
- [sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml) - Site map for crawlers
- Link response headers with `rel=api-catalog` are served on Vercel (see vercel.json); GitHub Pages serves the site statically and cannot provide response Link headers.

## Catalog

- [Free AI model directory](https://free-llm-models.custats.com/): Search and filter the current free model catalog by provider, modality, context length, reasoning, tools, and other capabilities.
- [Free models JSON](https://free-llm-models.custats.com/free_models.json): Machine-readable aggregate catalog with model metadata and provider identifiers.
- [Per-provider model index](https://free-llm-models.custats.com/models/index.json): Provider files and model counts used by the website.

## Pages

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://free-llm-models.custats.com/faq): API keys, first API calls, rate limits, integrations, and API key security.
- [Former free models](https://free-llm-models.custats.com/archive): Models that have left the current free catalog.
- [Model details](https://free-llm-models.custats.com/): Individual model pages use the URL pattern `/model/{encoded-model-id}`.

## Optional

- [OpenRouter documentation](https://openrouter.ai/docs): Provider API documentation and integration guides.
- [Project source](https://github.com/luongnv89/free-llm-models): Updater and web application source code.
